inventoryRemoveVariantStopsSelling: It stops being offered at the till. Sales already recorded keep the name they were sold under.
inventorySaveBeforeBarcode: Save the product first, then add its barcode(s).

settingsBackupHelp: Export a full backup regularly, and keep a copy somewhere safe off this phone.

settingsConnectMpesaMessage: This shop needs to be registered with the backend once. Sign in with the shop identity account; staff continue using local PINs for the till.
settingsCreateShopFailed: Couldn’t create the shop. Check the phone has storage free, then try again.
settingsEraseBackupsMessage: This permanently removes this phone’s backup key and encrypted backup files. Copies already shared to another device or cloud storage are not erased.
settingsIdentityLinkFailed: Could not link your online account. Check your connection and sign in with the same email you entered during setup.
settingsIdentityLinked: Online identity linked. M-Pesa and analytics are now available.

settingsInvalidEncryptedBackup: That encrypted backup is invalid or belongs to another installation.
settingsInvalidWorkbook: That workbook has invalid inventory data. No products were imported.
settingsLoadShopsFailed: Could not load shops. Connect to the internet and try again.
settingsMpesaOffSubtitle: Excluded — turn on to accept M-Pesa. Requires a one-time backend connection and a PayHero account.
settingsMpesaOnSubtitle: Included — customers can pay by M-Pesa STK push. Requires internet at checkout.
settingsMpesaUpdateFailed: Couldn’t update M-Pesa setting — check your connection and try again.

settingsPrinterUnreachable: Could not reach the printer. Check it is switched on and in range, then try again.
settingsPrintingPairedOffSubtitle: Paired, but switched off. Reprints still work.

settingsRemoveStaffMessage: {name} will no longer be able to sign in. Their past sales stay on record.
settingsSeparateOfflineDataSubtitle: Sales, stock, staff, and backups cannot mix between shops on this device.

settingsShopNotOnDevice: Set this shop up on this device first
settingsShopReady: {name} is ready. Your admin account and PIN carried across.
settingsSignInBeforeAddingShop: Sign in as the shop admin before adding another shop.
settingsStaffNameTaken: A staff member named "{name}" already exists
settingsStaffRemovedOffline: Cashier removed locally. Backend access will be updated on the next successful sync.
settingsStaffSavedOffline: Cashier saved offline. It will be linked to the backend on the next successful sync.
settingsStaffSectionHelp: The shop admin creates and disables manager and cashier profiles. Their local PIN is the offline till unlock; the same profile is synchronized to Keycloak-backed analytics when online.
settingsSyncFailed: Sync failed — try again when you have signal.
settingsSyncHelp: When online, sync pushes inventory and sales to a Google Sheet. With no signal, it saves an Excel file you can share manually instead — nothing is ever blocked by connectivity.
settingsSyncOfflineExcel: No internet — saved an Excel file instead. Share it from the prompt that opened.
settingsSyncSheets: Synced to Google Sheets just now.

shotCupsStopSellingMessage: {product} shots stop appearing at the till. Sales already recorded are untouched.
taxSettingsAdminOnly: Only the shop admin can change tax settings.
taxSettingsEtimsOffSubtitle: Off — sales are recorded but no tax invoice is issued. Turn this on once a TIN is registered.
taxSettingsEtimsOnSubtitle: On — every sale is filed with KRA. Sales keep working with no signal; receipts upload as soon as there is a connection.
taxSettingsEtimsUpdateFailed: Couldn’t update eTIMS. Check your connection and try again.
taxSettingsKraPinHelp: Enter the PIN exactly as printed on this shop's KRA certificate, including the P0 prefix. A PIN issued to the wrong business puts invoices on someone else's return.
taxSettingsKraUnreachable: Couldn’t reach KRA. Check the shop is linked and you have a connection, then try again.
taxSettingsKraUnreachableRetry: Couldn’t reach KRA. Try again when you have a connection.
taxSettingsPricesIncludeVatSubtitle: On: you type the shelf price and VAT is extracted from it. Off: you type the net price and VAT is added on top.
taxSettingsRegisterPinFirst: Register your KRA taxpayer PIN first.
taxSettingsSaveFailed: Couldn’t save. Check the phone has storage free.
taxSettingsTillCodeHelp: Letters and digits only. Every till in a shop needs its own code, because KRA rejects two tills issuing the same receipt number.
taxSettingsTillCodeRequired: Enter at least one letter or digit
taxSettingsTillCodeSubtitle: Receipts are numbered {code}-000001, and KRA needs that number to match the sequence it has on file. Give each till its own code.
taxSettingsTinMissingHelp: Receipts cannot be issued until this shop's KRA PIN is registered. Until then, sales are recorded but no tax invoice is issued.
taxSettingsTinRegisteredHelp: Invoices are issued against this PIN.
taxSettingsTinTooShort: A TIN is at least 4 characters
taxSettingsVatExempt: Exempt — receipts omit the VAT line entirely.
taxSettingsWaitForReceipts: Wait for receipts to be issued
taxSettingsWaitForReceiptsSubtitle: Queued automatically after every sale while online. Sales never wait for it.
taxSettingsWorkedExample: A KSh 100 sale carries KSh {vat} VAT, leaving KSh {net} net.
